summary: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an unsecured promissory note with its sponsor for up to $540,000, with monthly draws of $60,000 to fund trust account contributions for its ongoing SPAC business combination. The note is non-interest-bearing and repayable upon business combination or winding up. This is a routine working capital facility, not a special situation event. No terms, premium, advisors, or regulatory clock are present. What to watch: the filing signals the SPAC is still pursuing an initial business combination, but no deal has been announced.
